purpose: Executable repository-governance contract for RMD version changes and public scientific-core releases. A version bump must be atomic across package metadata, citation metadata, user-facing metadata, changelog and GitHub release/tag state. Scientific model maturity is tracked separately from artifact version.

current_public_release.release_name: v0.3.0 — Reference-mode closure and Accounting Spine recovery boundary

versioning_basis.rationale: v0.3.0 remains the immutable published Reference-mode closure and Accounting Spine recovery-boundary snapshot. Main now contains three classes of unreleased post-release progress: (1) scientific progress within the still-incomplete F4 boundary, where an ESA-2010 structural-zero adjudication and reproducible successor partial artifact expand exact stock identification from 15 to 25 cells while flow remains 15 cells and the canonical benchmark remains incomplete; (2) repository-governance and provenance hardening across source-vintage, processed-data and validation-recovery inventory/authority chains, including exact artifact bindings, explicit legacy/normative classifications and cross-registry parity checks; and (3) post-terminal evidence adjudication and monitoring-governance refinement, where genuinely new official-source clues for BNR BLS 2025-Q2 and Ministry of Finance exchange-operation topology were reviewed under frozen contracts, adjudicated NO_REOPEN, and recorded in a successor trigger-aware monitoring horizon without opening source materialisation, calibration, Accounting Spine, feedback or behavioural gates. These changes improve scientific traceability, reproducibility and future trigger discipline but do not complete F4, the multi-instrument Accounting Spine, behavioural activation, calibration or validation, and they do not alter the published v0.3.0 artifact. Therefore no immediate version bump is required.
versioning_basis.next_candidate_rationale: The default next substantive 0.x scientific-core milestone remains 0.4.0. Post-v0.3.0 partial-instrument improvements should accumulate into a coherent milestone rather than trigger a release individually; a narrowly scoped corrective release may use 0.3.1 when that classification is accurate.

release_preparation.release_name: v0.3.0 — Reference-mode closure and Accounting Spine recovery boundary

atomic_repository_surfaces.rule: Must equal the actual public release date when a release is published.
The Unreleased material included in the release must move under the new version/date heading.
Must be advanced atomically with the release preparation and finalized after publication.
Create a new immutable release-notes file for each public version; do not rewrite an older version file to describe newer work.

external_release_surfaces.rule: Create v<version> at the exact reviewed release commit; never move a published release tag to rewrite history.
Publish from the same v<version> tag and include release notes that state the current scientific maturity and non-claims.

pre_publish_gates: CITATION.cff release date and CHANGELOG release date agree with the intended publication date.
A versioned `releases/v<version>.md` file exists and matches the intended release version and scientific boundary.
Scientific CI and all required accounting/materialization audits are green on the exact release commit.
Release notes preserve current scientific boundaries and do not imply validated behavioural closure, causal identification or model completion unless those states are actually authorized.
No previously published version/tag is mutated to contain new code or scientific artifacts.
post_publish_verification: Git tag points to the exact reviewed release commit.
GitHub Release uses the same tag and version.
Repository version, package version, README badge, CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG remain synchronized.
The release page and CITATION metadata describe the same public artifact.
